reason: Chrome needs the tts permission for chrome.tts; Firefox doesn't know it and uses the Web Speech API instead (#44).
Chrome runs background.service_worker; Firefox ignores it and runs the same file from background.scripts (#43).

data_collection_permissions needs Firefox for Android 142, while the desktop minimum is 140 (#43). Android support is decided with the AMO submission (#52); remove this entry then, by adding gecko_android.strict_min_version 142.0 or dropping Android.
